out_of_scope: Rest provenance and sleep-counter world construction

replay_observation.shared_shape: A damaging move leaves the Rest user at low HP in the Showdown transcript; Rest then heals it to full, and the end-of-turn block includes the opposing survivor's Leftovers and, where applicable, poison residual.
replay_observation.engine_shape: Each replay contains a surviving engine branch with the expected residual components and a separate capped-lethal branch without them. The capped-lethal branch is only reachable because the current engine damage lattice does not contain the observed surviving damage value.

prediction.survivor: For a Rest turn that leaves both sides alive, every resulting branch must retain all eligible end-of-turn residual instructions in Gen 3 order, including Leftovers before poison for the same Pokemon.
prediction.terminal: For a Rest turn whose damage branch ends the battle before Rest can execute, no later residual instruction may be emitted.
prediction.retained_rows: The three retained identities will continue to miss until their observed damage values are representable. Altering residual scheduling cannot add the missing survivor branch and would make the valid capped-lethal branch incorrect.

stop_rule: Do not change residual scheduling unless a focused Rest fixture shows a surviving branch missing an otherwise eligible residual instruction, or a terminal branch emitting one. If both controls hold, fail closed and hand the shared damage-lattice defect to its dedicated lane.

focused_pins: surviving Rest turn with opposing Leftovers
surviving Rest turn with opposing Leftovers plus Toxic
terminal damage branch beside Rest with no residual tail
